summary_en: Annual dividend forecast for fiscal year ending November 2026 revised to 60 yen per share, comprising 50 yen in regular dividends (18 yen interim, 32 yen year-end) and 10 yen commemorative dividend to mark the company's 130th anniversary on December 3, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Commemorative Dividend for 130th Anniversary)
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, Nikkei (THE JAPAN WOOL TEXTILE CO., LTD.) announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026. The annual dividend per share has been increased from the previously forecast 50 yen to 60 yen. This comprises interim dividend of 18 yen and year-end dividend of 42 yen, which includes a regular dividend of 32 yen and a commemorative dividend of 10 yen.

The revision reflects the company's celebration of its 130th anniversary, which falls on December 3, 2026. The additional commemorative dividend of 10 yen per share is being distributed to express gratitude to shareholders and stakeholders for their long-standing support throughout the company's 130-year history.

The formal approval of the year-end dividend amount, including the commemorative dividend, is scheduled to be decided by the board of directors at a meeting in January 2027, in accordance with the company's articles of incorporation.
